title: The Butterfly Garden
claude_note: Claude communicates via THOUGHT BUBBLES - his thoughts are narrated by the Narrator voice, not spoken directly

scenes.title: The Hidden Waterfall
scenes.setting: Sparkling waterfall with rainbow mist, rocky cavern entrance

lines.text: Following the winding forest path, Sir James and Claude discovered something magical - a sparkling waterfall that painted rainbows in the misty air.
Claude nuzzled Sir James's hand gently, offering silent comfort.
Look Claude! There's something behind the waterfall! Do you see it?
The world around them felt alive with wonder.
Claude barked excitedly, his tail wagging as he spotted the hidden entrance behind the curtain of water.
Sir James remembered Gramps's wise words.

scenes.title: The Crystal Guardian
scenes.setting: Glowing crystal chamber with ethereal blue light

lines.text: Inside the cavern, crystals glowed with a soft blue light. And there, standing tall and shimmering, was the Crystal Guardian.
Claude nuzzled Sir James's hand gently, offering silent comfort.
Hello! I am Sir James. We come in peace and friendship.
Nature itself seemed to be watching, curious about what would happen next.
The Guardian's voice echoed like wind chimes. 'Young knight, to pass through my garden, you must show me the courage in your heart.'
Sir James took a deep breath, feeling brave.

scenes.title: The Crystal Puzzle
scenes.setting: Chamber of floating crystals, each glowing different colors

lines.text: Crystals of every color floated gently in the air around them. Each one hummed with its own special song.
Claude's nose twitched. He could smell something magical in the air!
Claude, I think we need to work together on this. What do you think, boy?
The moment felt special, like the beginning of something important.
Claude nuzzled Sir James's hand, and together they began to solve the crystal puzzle, matching colors and sounds.
Sir James felt a warm glow of courage in his heart.

scenes.title: The Crystal of Truth
scenes.setting: Central crystal throne room, magnificent and awe-inspiring

lines.text: In the heart of the cavern stood a magnificent throne made entirely of crystals, and upon it rested a glowing gem.
Claude stayed close to Sir James, his faithful eyes full of encouragement.
The Crystal of Truth! Gramps told me stories about this. It shows what's truly in your heart.
The air seemed to shimmer with possibility.
As Sir James approached, the crystal began to glow brighter, recognizing the kindness within him.
Sir James remembered Gramps's wise words.

scenes.title: Helping the Lost Creatures
scenes.setting: Dark tunnel with Sir James's crystal lighting the path

lines.text: Deeper in the cavern, Sir James heard tiny voices calling for help. Small cave creatures had lost their way in the dark.
Claude's ears perked up with curiosity. Something exciting was about to happen!
Don't worry, little friends! My crystal will light the way. Follow me and Claude!
Everything seemed to hold its breath in anticipation.
The grateful creatures followed the warm glow, chirping happily as Sir James led them safely home.
Sir James felt proud to be on this adventure.

scenes.title: The Crystal Bridge
scenes.setting: Transparent crystal bridge over glowing underground river

lines.text: Before them stretched a bridge made of pure crystal, spanning a river that glowed with soft golden light.
Claude tilted his head thoughtfully. His loyal heart was ready for anything.
It's beautiful, Claude. But we must be brave. One step at a time, together.
Sunlight danced through the leaves, creating patterns of gold and shadow.
With Claude by his side, Sir James crossed the crystal bridge, each step ringing like a gentle bell.
Sir James remembered Gramps's wise words.

scenes.title: The Ancient Knights
scenes.setting: Cave paintings showing knightly virtues and history

lines.text: On the cavern walls, ancient paintings told stories of knights who had come before - each one learning important lessons.
Claude's tail swished back and forth. This was going to be interesting!
Look Claude! These knights learned about courage, kindness, and truth. Just like Gramps teaches me!
Sunlight danced through the leaves, creating patterns of gold and shadow.
Sir James traced the paintings gently, feeling connected to all the brave knights who walked this path before him.
Sir James took a deep breath, feeling brave.

scenes.title: Emerging Victorious
scenes.setting: Cave exit with golden sunset streaming in

lines.text: As Sir James and Claude emerged from the crystal cavern, the setting sun painted the sky in brilliant oranges and golds.
Claude's tail swished back and forth. This was going to be interesting!
We did it, Claude! We learned that true beauty comes from helping others and being brave together!
Sunlight danced through the leaves, creating patterns of gold and shadow.
Claude barked happily, and somewhere behind them, the Crystal Guardian smiled, knowing another young knight had learned an important lesson.
Well done, my boy. The crystals showed you what was already in your heart - courage, kindness, and wonder.

virtue_choice.prompt: What should Sir James do next?

options.text: Take a moment to reflect on what was learned.

questions: What did Sir James learn about appreciation of nature's beauty in this chapter?
How did Claude help Sir James during the adventure?
What would you have done if you were Sir James?
Can you think of a time when you showed similar courage/kindness/wisdom?
